messages:
amal: FYI the low bridge on 7th by the pier turned into an impromptu splash zone. Car tried to ford it and regretted life choices. 20m outbound delays. :grimacing:
chloe: Oh no. Is that the one with the traffic cones that never seem to work?
ops-bot: OpsBot: Muni outbound delays ~15-25min near 7th/Pier due to standing water. Use 9th St detour where possible.
diego: Walked around it and spotted a rogue inflatable duck drifting past a bicycle wheel. This city.
frank: Poll time: who swapped commute? React with :bus: bus, :bike: bike, :walk: walked, :home: WFH today.
amal: :walk: detoured via the boardwalk. Wet socks but no bus sardines.
chloe: :home: delayed start, making coffee and pretending it's planned.
diego: :bike: took the long inland route, 10 extra mins but kept shoes dry.
frank: Also shoutout to facilities  they put up temporary barricades and a mop brigade is en route. Legend.
ops-bot: OpsBot: City crews dispatched to clear drain at 7th/Pier. Expected clearance ~1 hour. Updates at municipal alerts.
amal: If anyone loses umbrellas to the wind, check the bike rack by reception  found one yellow umbrella hostage.
chloe: Heading in slowly. Thanks for the heads up and the yellow umbrella update. :yellow_heart:
